program:
domain(person,[amanda,greta,noah]).

% Amanda is not disciplined.
axiom(s1,not(disciplined(amanda))).

% If Amanda is persistent, then she is both open-minded and a problem solver.
axiom(s2,rule([persistent(amanda)],and(open_minded(amanda),problem_solver(amanda)))).

% Amanda is motivated.
axiom(s3,motivated(amanda)).

% If Amanda is an experienced designer, then she either solves real-world problems or has attention to detail, but not both.
axiom(s4,rule([experienced_designer(amanda)],xor(solves_real_world_problems(amanda),attention_to_detail(amanda)))).

% If Greta is motivated, then she is either disciplined or persistent (but not both).
axiom(s5,rule([motivated(greta)],xor(disciplined(greta),persistent(greta)))).

% Anyone who has good taste or solves real-world problems can be an innovative designer.
axiom(s6,rule([or(good_taste(X),solves_real_world_problems(X))],innovative_designer(X))).

% Amanda is an experienced designer.
axiom(s7,experienced_designer(amanda)).

% If Amanda is motivated, then she is either disciplined or persistent (but not both).
axiom(s8,rule([motivated(amanda)],xor(disciplined(amanda),persistent(amanda)))).

% Amanda does not think critically.
axiom(s9,not(thinks_critically(amanda))).

% If Amanda has strong foundations, then she is either strategic or solves real-world problems (but not both).
axiom(s10,rule([strong_foundations(amanda)],xor(strategic(amanda),solves_real_world_problems(amanda)))).

% If someone sets high standards, then they work diligently and have attention to detail.
axiom(s11,rule([sets_high_standards(X)],and(works_diligently(X),attention_to_detail(X)))).

% If Amanda experiments with materials, then she is an innovative designer.
axiom(s12,rule([experiments_with_materials(amanda)],innovative_designer(amanda))).

% Every innovative designer either thinks outside the box or develops unique products (or both).
axiom(s13,rule([innovative_designer(X)],or(thinks_outside_the_box(X),develops_unique_products(X)))).

% Anyone who has visionary ideas thinks outside the box.
axiom(s14,rule([visionary_ideas(X)],thinks_outside_the_box(X))).

% Noah is an experienced designer.
axiom(s15,experienced_designer(noah)).

% Amanda does not value precision.
axiom(s16,not(values_precision(amanda))).

% All problem solvers are creative and think outside the box.
axiom(s17,rule([problem_solver(X)],and(creative(X),thinks_outside_the_box(X)))).

% For all people, if they either think critically or have attention to detail, then they value precision.
axiom(s18,forall(var(x,person),implies(or(thinks_critically(var(x)),attention_to_detail(var(x))),values_precision(var(x))))).

% Amanda does not develop unique products.
axiom(s19,not(develops_unique_products(amanda))).

% Amanda is open-minded.
axiom(s20,open_minded(amanda)).
